# NostrBorg

Sovereign encrypted Borg replication. Encrypted repository files are stored as opaque content-addressed blobs across independent replicas. Losing one replica must not lose the backup.

## Canonical URL
https://nostrborg.flowstate.market/

## What it does
- Public restore drill: create synthetic ciphertext blobs, upload to two replicas, destroy replica A, restore from replica B, byte-compare.
- Local Borg proofs remain in this repository for real `borg check --verify-data` restore after replica loss.
- ConsentKeys is used only for an optional operator dashboard. Recovery keys never go to the hosted app.

## Key pages
- / — product promise and public restore drill
- /dashboard — optional ConsentKeys operator view
- /privacy — privacy policy
- /terms — terms, including ConsentKeys identity-provider change rule
- /api/drill — POST synthetic dual-replica restore drill
- /api/health — liveness
- /sitemap.xml — sitemap
- /robots.txt — crawler policy

## Data model
- Hosted drill uses ephemeral synthetic ciphertext in a single request. No Borg passphrases or plaintext backups are stored.
- Authenticated identity, when configured, is ConsentKeys `sub` only.
